entries.title: Psalms 124:1
segments:
PSALM CXXIV. 
 
  David describes the danger he and his people had been in, ver. 1-5.   Blesses God for delivering them, ver. 6-8.   A song of degrees of David.

entries.title: Psalms 124:5
segments: V. 5. The proud-Our enemies, compared to proud waters, for their great multitude and swelling rage.
